name: pi-code-lens
description: code-lens as a native pi extension — one surface over two code-intelligence engines: semantic recall proposes, the knowledge graph disposes. Client-only: talks to the already-running shared lens service.

scripts.build:test: tsc extensions/index.ts --outDir .test-dist --rootDir . --module ES2022 --target ES2023 --moduleResolution bundler --skipLibCheck --strict false || true; bash scripts/link-pi-packages.sh
scripts.test: npm run build --silent && npm run build:test --silent && for t in test/*.mjs; do node "$t" || exit 1; done

codeLens.comment: The two capability engines are EXTERNAL PROCESSES, not npm imports. They are installed and supervised by `lens install`, and reached over a socket/CLI. Versions here are the tested floor, asserted by `lens doctor`.
